summary: Brookfield Infrastructure Partners L.P. and Brookfield Infrastructure Corp. filed a Form 6-K on July 30, 2026, reporting second-quarter 2026 results via press release. The filing details FFO per unit of $0.89, a 10% increase year-over-year, with net income of $44 million for the quarter. The release highlights strong performance in data and midstream segments, partially offset by higher depreciation and borrowing costs. It discusses the ongoing asset sale program, which moderated reported growth. This is a routine earnings announcement, not a special situation transaction. No deal terms, advisor recommendations, or strategic alternatives are disclosed.
